notes: The Verilator error is in the header (LPARA_STRB_W/REQ_W/RESP_W = Derived placeholder), not in the body. It must be replaced by the harness, e.g. PARA_APBCDC_DATA_W/8. The body uses no undefined identifiers. The async 1-time-step-after-falling-edge check is omitted because it would need a delay, which is disallowed.
